requirement_ledger.independent_low_volume_water_demo_tray: pass: removable inner pan and shallow 50 mL fill surface
requirement_ledger.water_level_and_high_level_indication: pass: sight gauge, float, maximum ring and discrete high-level flag
requirement_ledger.manual_drain_without_recirculation: pass: isolated valve, quarter-turn lever, cap and short drain lead
requirement_ledger.wet_dry_electrical_separation: pass: partition gasket and fasteners at B-to-A boundary

selected_defect: V08 retained the basic water tray but did not yet make its safe fill limit, independent drainage and dry/wet separation legible for physical fabrication.
source_repair: Add a three-sided removable inner catch pan, shallow level surface and physical maximum-fill marker.
Add a clear sight gauge, float, high-level flag and manual drain valve with cap; no recirculation route is created.
Add a mechanical gasket and bolts at the B-zone partition.
next_stage: Refine the A-zone electrical enclosure, service access and low-voltage wire management before preparing drawings and web bindings.
